thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 streaming latency spike on pool-shared-1 (streaming-read-service). p95=1.2s p99=9.6s error+5%. Auto-pager to eng-oncall and ops.

jen_ops: on it. I see a sudden nvme latency increase on host-shared-7. dashboard: https://redwood/metrics/host-shared-7

rishi_eng: joining. Any recent deploys to streaming-read-service?

deploy-bot: deployment streaming-read-service@2026.03.15-09:12 finished on pool-shared-1 (hosts: host-shared-5..host-shared-8)

laura_sre: pulling blkio stats now.

laura_sre: `cat /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/kubepods.slice/*/io.stat` shows high write_bytes for pod streamer-user-77 and continuous throttled count increments on host-shared-7.

jen_ops: CLI snippets:
```
$ kubectl get pods -o wide --selector=app=streamer -n prod
streamer-user-77   2/2 Running  host-shared-7
streamer-user-21   2/2 Running  host-shared-6
streamer-user-11   2/2 Running  host-shared-5
$ ssh host-shared-7 iostat -x 1 2
nvme0n1  r/s  w/s  rMB/s wMB/s await %util
        2.1 480.4 0.01 16.8 220.3 99.4
```

rishi_eng: streamer-user-77 is our main suspect. Any chance it's running a background batch job (compaction/export) while serving requests?

jen_ops: checking container logs: large periodic checkpointing every ~45s starting at 1762345400. Here's snippet:
```
[1762345400] INFO starting checkpoint compaction, estimated size 120GB
[1762345423] INFO checkpoint finished, duration 24s
```

laura_sre: that explains NVMe write bursts and long await. streaming reads are getting queued behind big writes.

cs_jordan: Customer impact: ticket #CS-12900 from enterprise customer 'NorthBay' reporting 15s stalls on live streams starting ~09:25. Multiple customers in last 20m.

rishi_eng: immediate options ranked by speed:
1) Pause the compaction job in streamer-user-77 (app-level signal).
2) Throttle pod I/O (blkio throttle iops or weight) via cgroup on host-shared-7.
3) Live migrate pod to write-optimized node or isolated dedicated pool (if capacity).
4) Fallback: route affected customers to standby streaming cluster (read-only degraded mode).

jen_ops: we have spare capacity in isolated-pool-w. Live migration looks doable in ~40s using `kube-migrate --fast`.

laura_sre: before migrating, I'd prefer to try `ionice` + lower cgroup weight as it's reversible quicker. Also set io.stat monitoring alarm to page if write_throughput > 100MB/s for >1min.

rishi_eng: app-signal to pause compaction might require a config flip; risky. Let's do rapid throttle + migrate as fallback.

jen_ops: applying temporary blkio throttle: `tools/blkio-control --pod streamer-user-77 --weight 80 --iops-write 2000` now.

incident-bot: [ACTION] jen_ops applied blkio controls to streamer-user-77 (action-id A-7763)

laura_sre: host metrics show nvme await dropping from 220ms -> 60ms within 30s. p99 latency improving to ~2.2s.

cs_jordan: updated customers: "We've applied mitigations and latency is improving. We'll follow up with RCA+remediation plan." — they appreciate the quick update.

rishi_eng: let's proceed to migrate the pod to isolated-pool-w to fully remove noisy neighbor risk. jen, please trigger migration when ready.

jen_ops: kicking off `kube-migrate --pod streamer-user-77 --target isolated-pool-w-2 --mode fast`

incident-bot: [ACTION] migration started (ticket INC-12900-mig)

jen_ops: migration complete; pod now on isolated-pool-w-2. verifications: streaming p99 now ~0.9s, errors down to baseline.

laura_sre: good. we should still dig into why checkpointing / compaction is so aggressive on that tenant. maybe config drift after deploy. rishi, can you check the release notes for the deploy earlier?

rishi_eng: looking — deploy toggled `checkpoint_window_ms` from 30s -> 45s for performance reasons. That increased compaction size and overlap with streaming. Noticed only in certain tenant config (user-77 has huge kv store), so impact was amplified.

jen_ops: action items (short):
- revert `checkpoint_window_ms` change for multi-tenant pools (noah to open PR)
- add a pre-deploy check: flag tenants with data volume > 1TB and warn when checkpoint window increases
- add IO-targeted SLO alerting (host nvme await and per-pod write MB/s)
- run compensation for affected customers if SLA breached (CS to track)

cs_jordan: noting CS action: prepare credits template + customer comms. logging CS ticket.

night-oncall: I'm taking the handoff for overnight monitoring. summary for oncall: "Noisy tenant IO (streamer-user-77) caused NVMe writeback contention on host-shared-7 after a config change increased checkpoint window. Mitigations: temporary blkio throttle and live migration to isolated pool; p99 latency recovered. RCA and remediation PRs in progress. Watch p99 and host-shared-7 nvme await." :thumbsup:

laura_sre: assigning postmortem to rishi_eng. please include timeline, deploy diff, detection gaps, and remediation ETA. rishi, can you own? ETA first draft in 48h.

rishi_eng: taking postmortem. I'll include suggested scheduler improvements to avoid pairing write-heavy pods with streaming-sensitive nodes.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT UPDATE] Impact: multiple streaming sessions stalled for ~22m. Mitigation: blkio throttle + migration. Status: monitoring and RCA assigned.

jen_ops: closing active pager. leaving thread open for RCA and follow-ups. great work team — nice quick mitigation.
